errors.evidence: The y-axis label is "句对数/s", which translates to "sentence pairs/s", not "sentences/second" (句/秒).
The y-axis scale is labeled with tick marks from 0 to 3000. Describing the range with the maximum data point (3516) is an inaccurate representation of the axis itself.
The major gridlines and labels on the y-axis are at 0, 1000, 2000, and 3000, indicating an interval of 1000, not 500.
